16731968.reason: Only colors that appear on some edge endpoint become candidates; colors of isolated vertices (diversity 0) are never considered. 0003: vertex 3 (color 4) is isolated, only color 13 is a candidate, prints 13; expected 4.

27007570.reason: Answer index initialised to 0 and only updated while scanning edges between different colors; if no edge joins different colors it prints the nonexistent color 0. 0003 prints 0; expected 4.

36547845.reason: Sorts the color list c before indexing c[a-1], destroying the vertex->color mapping, so edges are attributed to the wrong colors. Sample 0002 (4 2 5 2 4) prints 4; expected 2.

40556074.reason: Adds the neighbor's color without excluding u==v, so a vertex's own color is counted in Q(k), and also includes dummy color 0 from cc[0]. 0003: edge between two color-13 vertices gives |Q(13)|=1, prints 13; expected 4.

5007896.reason: Initialises the answer to color 1 with diversity 0 and only replaces it on a strictly larger set, so when every present color has empty Q(k) it prints color 1 even if no vertex has color 1. 0003 (colors 13 13 4, edge 1-2 joining equal colors) prints 1; expected minimum present color 4.
